use: Medieval fantasy background for the adventure stage map
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: background illustration for an existing medieval fantasy adventure-selection map in a Korean castle-defense browser game, landscape roughly 16:9.
Primary request: A richly hand-painted medieval fantasy world map, seen from above with small isometric landmarks, like a beautiful illustrated atlas of an enchanted kingdom. Ancient stone castles and watchtowers, winding rivers with tiny stone bridges, deep evergreen forests, rocky mountains, crystal caverns, snowy hills, old villages and mysterious ruins. A sinister wizard citadel belongs near the lower left, and a warm torch-lit starting settlement near the upper left; an adventurous sense of traveling from a safe kingdom toward a dark final fortress. These places are parts of one continuous landscape, not separate cards.
Style/medium: polished storybook game illustration, medieval manuscript cartography, subtle aged parchment texture, finely painted terrain, atmospheric dark fantasy with inviting detail suitable for children. Muted earth browns, moss greens, slate blues, antique gold, restrained luminous crystals.
Composition/framing: wide seamless world map filling the whole image, no decorative outer frame. Existing code will overlay eleven numbered stage buttons in a two-row winding route: six across the upper-middle at approximately 30% image height, five across the lower-middle at approximately 65% image height. Keep landscape detail lower contrast around those rows so buttons and stage captions are legible. Keep the upper 15% calmer and dark enough for a cream-colored title. Draw natural terrain and subtle paths only, never numbered nodes or interface controls.
Lighting/mood: soft atmospheric medieval fantasy, dark brown/blue-green shadowed edges, gentle warm highlights, readable and detailed, not grim horror.
Constraints: no text, letters, numbers, labels, logos, watermark, UI, buttons, icons, stars or borders. Not a screenshot. No modern structures. Produce a completed opaque landscape background illustration.
